speaker: KYLAE
description: Kylae is a middle-aged woman with a composed, authoritative presence. She speaks at a deliberate pace, maintaining calm under pressure but with an underlying tension when discussing anomalies. ref_text: I am Kylae Kuosi, the high priestess of this temple. ...servant of the Highest Ones, I implore you to grace us with your presence.
